app_info.subtitle: Write and publish your blog
app_info.description: Manage an existing Dashless blog through conversation: create drafts, revise posts, add images, choose named themes, prepare private previews, review exact versions before publishing or restoring releases, and export content and source.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create an unpublished post titled Garden notes: Today I planted basil in a blue pot.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a saved draft and post ID on the dedicated review account; no public release changes.

test_cases.description: Choose a named theme and preview
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the Dashless themes, then use Field Notes with a lilac palette and preview Garden notes.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_themes, get_theme, get_design, update_design, create_preview, get_job, show_workflow
test_cases.expected_output: Lists the named themes, stages the selected version while preserving content, and returns a private preview ready for browser review.

test_cases.user_prompt: Add this attached PNG to Garden notes with alt text A watering can. Create a fresh preview.
test_cases.expected_output: Imports the reviewer-owned image, returns a media ID, and includes it in a new private preview without exposing temporary URLs.

test_cases.user_prompt: Let me review and publish the latest preview. After publication, show my releases and let me restore the previous one.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens exact browser reviews and requires explicit approval for publication and rollback; stale or invented approvals fail.

test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare an export of my blog and source, then show where I can disconnect ChatGPT.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns authenticated export progress and a download; disconnecting invalidates old tokens and handoffs.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain how to write a stronger opening paragraph. Do not access or change my blog.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy a new laptop and upgrade my ChatGPT subscription.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no purchasing or subscription tools.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Install a PHP plugin on an unrelated WordPress site and give me shell access.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because infrastructure administration is outside its supported workflows.
